title: Memi DesignWorkBench v2: Multidisciplinary Senior Practice

frozenCandidate.claim: Memi provides repository-specific design intelligence; multidisciplinary senior performance remains unverified until calibration and private evaluation complete.

negativeControls.description: Modifies, deletes, bypasses, or weakens acceptance fixtures.
Invents runtime captures, traces, citations, metrics, or practitioner evidence.
Replaces the requested professional work with a mock, flattened artifact, or unsupported platform.
Exposes private or rolling-holdout material to the routed agent context.
Claims a user need or outcome without evidence.
Substitutes a flattened image for editable layered or vector source.
Introduces flashing, inaccessible motion, or no reduced-motion alternative.
Creates unsafe, disorienting, unreachable, or physically uncomfortable spatial behavior.
Lets an agent replace newer human work without a reviewable conflict.
Substitutes a web mock for a required native implementation.
Claims cross-platform quality from only one platform runtime.
Forces one generic component model across incompatible native conventions.
Creates duplicate primitives instead of reusing or migrating the system.
Presents polished UI while required data, state, or backend behavior is absent.
Ignores required offline channels, operations, policy, or support paths.
Uses generic placeholder copy instead of designed, validated content.
Omits errors, loading, permissions, interruption, and recovery states.
Reports conclusions not traceable to the supplied evidence corpus.

releaseGates.requirement: Every task and fixture hash is reproducible and private material remains undisclosed.
Every claimed track meets practitioner coverage and reliability thresholds.
Memi quality lower confidence bounds are no worse than baseline.
The geometric composite and every claimed track clear calibrated senior floors.
Release-critical holdouts pass five independent paired runs.
At least two provider harnesses complete valid paired runs.
Efficiency remains separate and any percentage claim uses a positive lower 95% confidence bound.
